llm_response.reason: The site is a newly registered (July 2025) domain with privacy-shielded ownership apparently located in China, yet purports to be a Puma Ecuador retail store, likely spoofing the legitimate Puma brand (characteristic 16). The pages display large catalogs of branded goods at suspiciously low prices (characteristic 1), with ambiguous privacy statements and no verified business/company details (characteristics 4 and 7). Contact information is incomplete or missing (characteristic 6), and there is no genuine connection to official Puma retail operations. All this aligns with classic fake e-commerce scam traits.
